item.title: Scenario Planning and Foresight: new challenges, emerging practices, and evolving frontiers
item.content:encoded:
This special issue invites research on scenario planning and foresight methods, exploring contemporary challenges and innovative approaches in the field. The issue welcomes contributions that examine emerging practices and novel applications of these forward-looking techniques across various domains.
